title: Image prompt
description: prompts/prompt-NNN.json — one self-contained generation request per scene. An external image-generation module must be able to consume this file alone, without reading the story, scenes, or bibles.

prompt.description: Complete positive prompt: subject + action + expression + setting + time/weather/light + camera + full visual style. All bible attributes embedded verbatim — no references.

caption.description: Caption text for downstream overlay (empty if none); the image itself must contain no text

continuity_anchors.description: The exact visual facts that must match neighbouring scenes — usable by an image module to validate or regenerate

source_scene.description: Project-relative path to the scene file this prompt was derived from
